description: Search the local GitLab action catalog. Read-only and no GitLab API call. Use when the action ID or params are unclear. Returns schemas, hints, destructive flags, and execute examples.

explain.description: When true, include deterministic scoring reasons for each returned action. Defaults to false to keep responses compact.

limit.description: Maximum number of matches to return. Defaults to 20 and is capped at 50.

query.description: Search terms combining a GitLab domain or resource with a verb, filter, or object name, such as project create, merge request approve, pipeline retry, issue delete, or ci variable. At most 256 characters: a longer query is refused, not truncated.

name: gitlab_find_action

results.description: Matching GitLab catalog actions with schemas and execute examples.

action.description: Action name inside the catalog group.

ambiguous_with.description: Other canonical action IDs that share the exact ambiguous alias used in the query.

destructive.description: Whether this action requires explicit confirmation.

explanation.description: Optional scoring explanation returned only when explain is true.

low_confidence.description: Whether the result is considered low confidence.

margin_to_next.description: Score difference to the next ranked result when known.

matched_terms.description: Number of normalized query terms that matched this action.

reasons.description: Deterministic match reasons that contributed to the score.

alternative.description: Expanded synonym or verb alternative that matched, when different from the original term.

distance.description: Levenshtein edit distance for fuzzy matches.

field.description: Action metadata field that matched the query term.

fuzzy.description: Whether this match came from typo-tolerant fuzzy recovery.

score.description: Score contributed by this match before final match-ratio scaling.

required_terms.description: Minimum number of normalized query terms required for this action to match.

total_score.description: Final score returned for the action after match-ratio scaling.

id.description: Canonical action ID to pass to gitlab_execute_action.

input_schema.description: Exact JSON Schema for action-specific params.

low_confidence.description: Whether the top result is below the high-confidence score or margin threshold.

output_schema.description: Best-effort JSON Schema for the action result.

parameter_guidance.description: Parameter binding guidance for commonly confused params.

related_actions.description: Curated nearby action IDs for workflows where ordering matters.

required_params.description: Required action-specific parameter names to place inside gitlab_execute_action params.

schema_uri.description: MCP resource URI for the action parameter schema.

score.description: Lexical relevance score for the query.

usage.description: Short disambiguation note for commonly confused actions.

title: GitLab Find Action
